created.name: helper_assert_observation_group
created.description: Asserts that each observation in the array has the expected group assignment. Prints a message if a mismatch is found.

created.name: helper_assert_cluster_centroid
created.description: Asserts that the centroids of clusters match the expected x and y values within a small epsilon. Prints a message if a mismatch is found.

created.name: helper_generate_observations_circle
created.description: Generates an array of observations placed evenly on a circle of given radius and center. The caller is responsible for freeing the returned array.

created.name: helper_free_clusters
created.description: Frees the memory allocated for the clusters array.
